expectation: Membrane CD7 on a sizeable subset of T and NK cells: small round bright cells scattered singly or in clusters among stroma and tumour, varying in density by region. Nuclei would be unstained and the signal ring-like.
observed: A: many tiles show discrete small yellow cell-sized spots, dense in some tiles (top left, top middle) and sparse in others, with dark yellow-free tissue in between. B/C: a few small, sharply bounded bright cells over otherwise clean tissue. D: a clump of bright cells at pixel resolution.
why: Discrete, cell-sized yellow spots form a distinct subset that varies by region over clean background, as expected for CD7 on T and NK cells.
